reply:
rem is relative to the root element (html). em is relative to the parent element.

So when you set `font-size: 2rem` on a nested element, it's 2× the root font-size, not 2× the parent's size. That's why it looked much bigger than expected—if your root is 16px (default), 2rem = 32px regardless of nesting depth.

If you want 2× the parent's size, use `font-size: 2em`.
